title: feat(question): a shot from the tapped tile — into the corner on a goal, wide on a miss
body:
**Size:** L  
**Design:** [Goal & miss animation canvas](https://claude.ai/artifact/Xk2NPWmqxGcMiQqUPUzzav): a playable prototype (level 3, question 3/3, on the 2.0 photo stage) and the shot library with the beat timeline  
**Spec:** [`docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-15-play-redesign-2-0-design.md`](https://github.com/tovmassian/escuadra/blob/main/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-15-play-redesign-2-0-design.md#6-motion): §2.4 (answer flow), §6 (motion), §8 (tokens)

When a question is decided, a ball is struck from the tapped tile. On a right answer it flies into the escuadra corner and the corner shakes: the goal, _a la escuadra_. On a miss it goes wide, right or left, and is lost off-screen without ever crossing the corner. This replaces §6's 10 pt drop into the corner and the bounce off the post.

It fires only when the question is decided: the last part answered right (a goal), or any part answered wrong (a miss, since a wrong part ends the question). A correct earlier part on level 2 or 3 keeps today's slot pulse.

### Shots

Each verdict picks one shot at random, never the same one twice running, with a random side and some jitter. The prototype's generator is the reference for the shapes.

- **Goals** decelerate into the corner and enter through its open (lower-left) side, so the ball never seems to pass through the frame: Curler, Driven, Dipping lob, Trivela. The flight is 260 ms times a factor for each shot: 213–291 ms.
- **Misses** keep their pace and leave the screen: Wide right, Wide left, Sliced right, Dragged left. A miss path never comes within 28 dp of the corner's frame (ball edge to frame); a path that would is re-rolled. The frame never moves on a miss.
- **Depth:** the ball's size reads as height. It leaves the tile at about 1.7× the corner's ball, is biggest at the top of the arc, and lands at `sizes.corner.question.ball`, so a goal ends exactly as the corner looks today. A short trail of three fading balls follows it.

### Beats after the tap

| | Goal | Miss |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | Tile turns green, pops | Tile turns red, shakes |
| 60 | Slot chip fills | Right answer turns green |
| 80 | Ball leaves the tile | Ball leaves the tile |
| 140 | | "Got it — next" rises in |
| ~185 | | Corner turns red as the ball goes by |
| 293–371 | Ball lands; corner turns green and shakes (240 ms); ring flash (300 ms); ball settles (140 ms) | |
| ~380 | | Ball is off-screen |
| 1,200 | Auto-advance, unchanged | Waits for the tap, unchanged |

Every animation stays under 300 ms. The goal's beats chain to about 640 ms, inside the 1,200 ms auto-advance pause, so a round takes no longer.

### Work

- [ ] A pure shot planner in `lib/` (no React, no store): given the tap point, the corner, the verdict and a seed, it returns the path, the ball's scale and opacity over time, and when the corner reacts. Tests beside it, as `lib/` keeps them today:
  - every goal ends at the corner's rest point, coming in from the open side
  - no miss comes within 28 dp of the corner, over many seeds
  - no shot repeats twice running; the same seed gives the same path
- [ ] An overlay on the question screen (`app/play/[squadId]/[level]/index.tsx`) above the tiles, `pointerEvents="none"`: the ball and its trail, driven by one Reanimated shared value sampling the precomputed path on the UI thread
- [ ] Measure the tap point and the corner's live position at launch, after the 60 ms slot fill: on level 3 a long answer can reflow the chip row and move the corner
- [ ] `EscuadraCorner`: drop the 10 pt drop and the post bounce; add the impact shake and the ring flash; the colour turns at impact (goal) or as the ball goes by (miss), not on the tap; the ball rests in the corner after a goal, as today
- [ ] Tokens in `theme/tokens.ts`:
  - durations: shot flight, settle, corner shake, ring
  - `spotlightMotion`: the start and swell scales, the 28 dp clearance, the trail offsets
  - `spotlightCues.ball` stays 80
  - colours from the active palette (`success`, `error`) through `useThemeColors()`
- [ ] Reduce Motion (`useReducedMotion`): no flight, no shake, colour only; on a goal the ball appears in the corner, as today's reduced path does
- [ ] Spec §6 says mid-round "everything finishes within 300 ms". Update that rule and §6's Correct and Miss rows for the chained beats, and the "never mid-round" note on `celebrationEasingCurves` in `theme/tokens.ts`, in this PR
- [ ] Haptics (§7) stay on the tap
- [ ] `design/SCREENS.md` if it describes the corner's motion; regenerate `design/screens`

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] On all three levels and in both themes, every goal lands in the corner through its open side
- [ ] No miss crosses or comes near the corner; the ball leaves the screen
- [ ] It fires only when the question is decided
- [ ] Every animation stays under 300 ms; auto-advance and "Got it — next" keep their timing
- [ ] Reduce Motion shows colour only
- [ ] Smooth on a mid-range Android: the animation runs on the UI thread, with no JS-driven frames
- [ ] `npm run check` passes

### Open before building

- Depth: "Lob swell" (above, the prototype's default) or "At camera", where the ball keeps growing and snaps into the corner. Both are in the prototype's Tweaks panel.
- The trail: on (default) or off.
